newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar holds steady upto close.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar holds steady upto close.

text.p: White sugar futures held steady during the later part of an uneventful day aided by some shortcovering ahead of the Christmas/New Year holiday's.
Taders said little activity was expected next week but the recent bearish sentiment was likely to persist due to abundant supply of quality whites, normal for the season.
At the close March was trading at $305.20, up $1.50 a tonne from Thursday, while other positions were between $1.90 up and $2.10 a tonne down. Turnover totalled 2,0442 lots.
In Paris March ended at $305.50, up $1.50.
